# The Quentin Skills

> The Quentin's skill library: 59 skills across six groups, documenting what each one does, who it is for, and how to call it, on top of one doctrine — human judgment holds the gates, trusted agents do the work in between.

## Home

- [The Quentin Skills](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/): Catalog home — journeys, groups, and the full skill index.

## Journeys

- [Deliver with evidence](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/journey/deliver-with-evidence/): Five skills in delivery order, from reading a codebase to a reviewed merge.
- [Run a product org](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/journey/run-a-product-org/): Four skills in pm order, from a raw problem to a leadership pack.

## For leaders

- [For leaders](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/leaders/): What the skill library changes for delivery and product, framed by the four human gates.

## Groups

- [Core — shared doctrine](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/group/core/): Doctrine and tooling more than one group needs; every group may reference it.
- [Developer — the AI-native SDLC](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/group/developer/): Inception through maintenance, four human gates, verified agent work between them.
- [PM — the AI-native transformation practice](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/group/pm/): Discovery through benefits realization, mirroring the developer group's four gates.
- [Branding](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/group/branding/): One verbal, visual, accessible, physical, and motion system across product UI, documents, print, environments, and video.
- [Writing](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/group/writing/): Skills that make writing better, in the repository's own explainer voice. Charter — planned.
- [Productivity](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/group/productivity/): Personal and team automations worth never doing by hand again.

## Skills

### Core

- [grit](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/grit/): Completion discipline for agent work — acceptance-gate ledger, verification depth, met/unmet/abandoned audit.
- [research](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/research/): Investigate against primary sources and capture cited findings as a file in the repository.
- [retro](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/retro/): Mine run traces for repeating failure patterns and propose skill changes a human approves.

### Developer

- [conduct](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/conduct/): Chooses loop, graph, or hybrid execution, assigns a model per node, maps to harness adapters.
- [model-routing](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/model-routing/): Resolves the tier and role assignment for a task node from the canonical model registry.
- [update-models](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/update-models/): Researches provider catalogs and proposes an evidence-backed update to the model registry.
- [impact](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/impact/): Idea-to-PRD pipeline — grill loop, value probing, governance-tier recording, backlog handoff.
- [recon](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/recon/): Brownfield codebase brief via signal-first archetype triage; read-only.
- [slice](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/slice/): Decomposes a signed PRD into epics, features, stories, and operability items.
- [raise](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/raise/): Publishes a sliced backlog to GitHub, Linear, or Azure DevOps with pickup-protocol labels.
- [sdlc](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/sdlc/): Full gated SDLC loop — SPEC-TS ledger, human gates, verifier challenge.
- [architect](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/architect/): Cross-cutting technical design and ADRs at the design gate.
- [safeguard](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/safeguard/): Security assessment and hardening at the secure-DevOps gate.
- [deliver](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/deliver/): CI/CD, supply chain, release readiness, stacked PRs, and repo setup.
- [operate](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/operate/): Post-release lane — SLOs and incident readiness, test gaps, patch cadence and debt burn-down.
- [shakedown](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/shakedown/): Sandbox build, test, execute, and agent-reviewed pass on a pull request before merge.
- [ask-fde](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/ask-fde/): Routes intent to the correct developer, pm, or branding skill.
- [responsible-ai-governance](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/responsible-ai-governance/): Regulated-industry and responsible-AI governance overlay on the stack rules.
- [tdd](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/tdd/): Test-first delivery of one vertical slice at a time, refactoring only under green.
- [debug](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/debug/): Gated diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions, one hypothesis at a time.
- [prototype](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/prototype/): Throwaway build answering one design question, then deleted or deliberately graduated.
- [refactor](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/refactor/): Survey a codebase for deepening opportunities, then work the one a human picks.
- [glossary](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/glossary/): Build the project's shared language, each term with an explicit avoid list.
- [triage](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/triage/): Move issues through triage roles, one state at a time, ending in an agent-ready brief.
- [wizard](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/wizard/): Generate a resumable shell wizard for the steps only a human can perform.

### PM

- [arrange](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/arrange/): Chooses grill-loop, parallel-fan, or hybrid execution shape for multi-round pm work.
- [chart](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/chart/): Charts work too big for one session as decision tickets, resolved one at a time.
- [constitution](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/constitution/): Authors and reviews the Product Constitution — principles, positioning, quarterly review.
- [discover](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/discover/): Business problem discovery and root-cause analysis for product and program managers.
- [map](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/map/): Personas, process flows, and the Business Understanding Document.
- [tom-architect](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/tom-architect/): Target Operating Model — L1-L4 processes, maturity, RACI, platform mapping.
- [carve](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/carve/): DIVE-tested epic decomposition into a manifest before PRDs are drafted.
- [prd-draft](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/prd-draft/): One INVEST-compliant PRD per approved epic, with a nine-check structural validation pass.
- [prd-review](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/prd-review/): Scores a PRD with the 11-Star Experience Framework across seven weighted dimensions.
- [case](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/case/): Business case with agent-fleet costing for the Investment gate.
- [roadmap](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/roadmap/): Now/next/later sequencing and Program Increment planning.
- [raid](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/raid/): Maintains the Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies registers.
- [realize](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/realize/): Tracks benefits realization against case and PRD projections and the north star.
- [report](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/report/): 4Ps leadership pack — Progress, Problems, Priorities, Perspective — at five cadences.
- [grill](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/grill/): Plain, grill-with-docs, or provoke interrogation of a pm artifact before a gate.
- [ask-pm](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/ask-pm/): Routes intent to the correct pm skill.

### Branding

- [everforest-branding](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/everforest-branding/): Calm, natural, editorial branding across digital, print, environmental, and motion surfaces with an accessible Everforest profile.
- [catppuccin-branding](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/catppuccin-branding/): Expressive pastel branding across digital, print, environmental, and motion surfaces with accessible Catppuccin light and dark roles.
- [ai-branding](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/ai-branding/): An Anthropic-inspired editorial system by default, or a separate OpenAI-inspired monochrome profile with open-source fonts.
- [gruvbox-branding](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/gruvbox-branding/): Warm retro-modern branding across digital, print, environmental, and motion surfaces with accessible Gruvbox light and dark roles.
- [nord-branding](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/nord-branding/): Cool, spacious branding across digital, print, environmental, and motion surfaces with accessible Nord light and dark roles.
- [solarized-branding](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/solarized-branding/): Disciplined blue-and-gold branding across digital, print, environmental, and motion surfaces with accessible Solarized light and dark roles.
- [press](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/press/): Renders an approved markdown document to a branded, self-contained HTML page and a PDF.
- [branding-system](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/branding-system/): Common engine for applying a validated theme profile as one coherent verbal, visual, accessibility, physical, and motion system.
- [exhibit](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/exhibit/): Builds one self-contained, interactive HTML page that walks a reader through a topic as a journey, in a selected theme's colors, type, and motion.
- [atlas-azure](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/atlas-azure/): Builds an evidence-grounded Azure reference architecture from a repository or plan, with numbered official-icon SVG diagrams and a branded PDF.

### Writing

- [freewrite](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/freewrite/): Mine raw fragments with generation held apart from judgment, keeping contradictions.
- [outline](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/outline/): Order fragments into beats, grounding every term before a beat leans on it.
- [draft](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/draft/): Render an outline into prose one beat at a time, with an auditable coverage map.

### Productivity

- [brief](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/brief/): Authors the rules, definitions, and boundaries a team's AI agents read, per tool surface.
- [handoff](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/handoff/): Project a run's trace into a document another session or person picks up cold.
- [questionnaire](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/questionnaire/): Turn a decision you cannot answer alone into questions for the one person who can.
- [wait-what](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/wait-what/): Diagnose why an explanation failed, then take a different route to the same point.
- [teach](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/teach/): Teach a concept across sessions, checking understanding by application rather than recall.
- [spotlight](https://tqnonline.github.io/skills/spotlight/): Turn established context into the smallest source-grounded visual that helps a human understand or decide.

## Doctrine sources

- [Repository](https://github.com/tqnonline/skills): Source for every skill, doctrine document, and test in this catalog.
- [Skills tree](https://github.com/tqnonline/skills/tree/main/skills): Every skill's SKILL.md and shared doctrine, grouped by area.

Note: the site currently serves from tqnonline.github.io/skills; URLs will be updated if a custom domain is adopted later.
